paragraphs: He is mentioned in Taanit 7b, raising an objection to Ravina; Hyman reports that Rashi there reads Mar Zeiri of Diheivat.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Taanit 7b paragraph has untitled Zeiri of Diheivat addressing Ravina. Hyman’s Zeira and מדיהבות remain distinct from the digital Zeiri and מדיהבת. His objection characterization and Rashi/Mar Zeiri report remain attributed claims; Rashi was not freshly collated and no name or place identity is bound.
